name: Wah-Wah-Wonderful
source:
Wah-wah-wonderful is a short dating-sim style game about Nintendo's Waluigi, made for a friend. Adventure as the head of the Waluigi fanclub, and meet a mysterious stranger! Who knows how she might change your fate?

[From [url=https://lydiae.itch.io/wah-wah-wonderful] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《哇哇好棒棒》是一款以任天堂瓦路易吉为主角的短篇恋爱模拟风格游戏，为一名朋友制作。作为瓦力欧粉丝俱乐部的会长展开冒险，结识一名神秘陌生人！谁知道她会如何改变你的命运？

（来源：[url=https://lydiae.itch.io/wah-wah-wonderful]itch.io[/url]）
